description: South East Queensland - Population, Housing, Jobs, Connectivity and Liveability is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications and the Arts (DITRDCA). A research project and report produced by the Bureau of Communications, Arts and Regional Research (BCARR) on the South East Queensland (SEQ) region. This report provides an evidence base on the spatial distribution of population growth, jobs, connectivity and liveability of SEQ. This evidence base can be used to monitor how population, jobs, connectivity and liveability change over time and respond to investment. Coverage is the states and territories, 2011 to 2022; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-07-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
